description: Defines classes and functions related to DNS HTTPS record RDATA, including parsing, equality checks, and type identification for HTTPS DNS records.

classes.name: HttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Abstract base class for HTTPS DNS record RDATA, providing interface for equality, type, and subtype conversions.

classes.name: AliasFormHttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents an alias form of HTTPS record RDATA with an alias name.

classes.name: ServiceFormHttpsRecordRdata
classes.description: Represents a service form of HTTPS record RDATA with detailed service parameters.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Static method to parse raw data into an HttpsRecordRdata object.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the DNS type of the record.

methods.name: IsAlias
methods.description: Indicates if the record is an alias.

methods.name: alias_name
methods.description: Returns the alias name for AliasFormHttpsRecordRdata.

methods.name: priority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the service form record.

methods.name: mandatory_keys
methods.description: Returns the set of mandatory keys.

methods.name: alpn_ids
methods.description: Returns the list of ALPN IDs.

methods.name: default_alpn
methods.description: Indicates if default ALPN is used.

methods.name: unparsed_params
methods.description: Returns the map of unparsed parameters.

methods.name: IsSupportedKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is supported.

methods.name: IsCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the parser is compatible with the parsed data.
